career_ladder.note: Field Engineers and Executive Trainees at SJVN Limited undergo 1 year of training or tenure engagement before regular absorption into the permanent executive cadre in IDA Grade E-2, advancing through SJVN's executive promotion framework across hydro, solar, and thermal generation projects.

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted through an All-India Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Personal Interview (for Executive Trainees) or Document Verification based on CBT merit (for Field Engineers).

financial_package.note: Field Engineers and Executive Trainees are placed in IDA Grade E-2 with basic pay ₹50,000 (or equivalent consolidated field pay). Compensation includes 58% IDA constant as of 2025-07-01, project allowances for mountainous hydropower project sites, cafeteria perks (35%), and HRA (up to 27%).
financial_package.pay_source_label: SJVN Compensation Structure and Remuneration Circular
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Basic Pay ₹50,000, 58% IDA (₹29,000), HRA (up to 27% = ₹13,500), and Cafeteria Perks @ 35% (₹17,500), less statutory deductions for PF and Insurance.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
Company project township accommodation or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Cafeteria allowances up to 35% of basic pay
Difficult area / project location allowance for remote Himalayan project sites
Comprehensive medical treatment for employee and dependent family members
Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, and Group Insurance Scheme
